candidate_relations.reason: The record supports Coccidioides meningitis with pseudosubarachnoid hemorrhage through high serum and CSF complement-fixation titers, lymphocytic hypoglycorrhachic meningitis, leptomeningeal thickening, and pulmonary findings. Subarachnoid neurocysticercosis is a distinct parasitic diagnosis and is not established here.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different infectious etiology despite involvement of the subarachnoid space.
